panes.title: Art Repl Audit
panes.command: bash -lc 'source .env 2>/dev/null || true; if [[ -n "${ART_BASE_URL:-}" && ( -n "${ART_TOKEN:-}" || ( -n "${ART_USERNAME:-}" && -n "${ART_PASSWORD:-}" ) ) ]]; then bash scripts/artifactory-replication-audit.sh; else echo "Set ART_BASE_URL and ART_TOKEN (or ART_USERNAME/ART_PASSWORD) to run replication audit."; fi'

panes.title: Art Pkg Check
panes.command: bash -lc 'source .env 2>/dev/null || true; if [[ -n "${ART_BASE_URL:-}" && ( -n "${ART_TOKEN:-}" || ( -n "${ART_USERNAME:-}" && -n "${ART_PASSWORD:-}" ) ) ]]; then bash scripts/artifactory-package-resolution-check.sh ${ART_REPO_KEYS:-}; else echo "Set ART_BASE_URL and ART_TOKEN (or ART_USERNAME/ART_PASSWORD), plus ART_REPO_KEYS if needed, to run package resolution checks."; fi'

panes.title: Art 502 Triage
panes.command: bash -lc 'source .env 2>/dev/null || true; if [[ -n "${ART_BASE_URL:-}" ]]; then bash scripts/artifactory-502-triage.sh; else echo "Set ART_BASE_URL to run 502 triage."; fi'

panes.title: Art Log Scope
panes.command: bash -lc 'source .env 2>/dev/null || true; if [[ -n "${ART_LOG_SCOPE_INPUT:-}" ]]; then bash scripts/artifactory-log-scope.sh --mode summary ${ART_LOG_SCOPE_INPUT}; else echo "Set ART_LOG_SCOPE_INPUT to one or more request log files to run scope analysis."; bash scripts/artifactory-log-scope.sh --help | sed -n "1,12p"; fi'
